script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Workplace
Theme: forgiveness

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. OFFICE BLDG - DAY

A bustling office building. DESK JOCkeys pound away at their keyboards. The A.D/ASSR, ALICE, walks through the maze of cubicles, her eyes scanning documents.

ALICE
(V.O)
Forgiveness... It's something I've been grappling with for weeks now.

INT. ALICE'S OFFICE - DAY

Alice sits at her desk, her computer humming softly. A knock at the door. Her boss, THOMAS, enters.

THOMAS
Alice, I need to talk to you about the Johnson project.

ALICE
(sighs)
I know, it's not going well.

THOMAS
No, it's worse than that. We've lost the account.

Alice's face falls.

THOMAS
But I'm not here to dwell on the past. I want to know what you're going to do about it.

INT. ALICE'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

Alice sits on her couch, a glass of wine in hand. The phone rings. She looks at it, then away. It rings again. She picks it up.

ALICE
(sighs)
Hello?

MARK
Alice? It's Mark. From the Johnson account.

Alice hesitates.

MARK
I know what I did was wrong. I took a shortcut and it cost us the account. But I've been thinking about it and I want to make things right.

ALICE
(bitterly)
And how do you plan on doing that?

MARK
I was thinking of coming to your office tomorrow and apologizing in person.

Alice's face softens.

ALICE
(sighs)
Fine. I'll be there.

INT. OFFICE BLDG - DAY

The next day, Mark arrives at Alice's office. She looks up as he enters.

MARK
Alice, I want to apologize for what I did. I know it was a mistake and I take full responsibility.

ALICE
(sighs)
You're right, it was a mistake. But it's not just about that. It's about trust. And right now, I don't have any trust left to give.

MARK
I understand. But I want to earn it back. I want to work with you to make things right.

Alice hesitates, then nods.

ALICE
Fine. We'll work together to salvage what we can from the Johnson project.

INT. OFFICE BLDG - WEEKS LATER

The office building is quieter now. Alice and Mark work together at a table, their heads bent over documents.

ALICE
(softly)
You know, Mark, I've been thinking about what you said earlier. About forgiveness.

MARK
(smiling)
Yes?

ALICE
I've come to realize that forgiveness isn't just about the person who's done the wrong thing. It's about me, and my ability to let go of the past and move forward.

MARK
(smiling)
That's a powerful realization. And I'm glad we've been able to work through this together.

Alice smiles back.

ALICE
(softly)
Me too.

FADE OUT.

THE END
